<Diagram name="system" alt="Jōge's system: your browser and wallet pair over WizardConnect, read coins from Fulcrum and build every entry; round contracts on Bitcoin Cash hold every pot; General Protocols signs prices; the engine relays prices, indexes the chain into Postgres, runs the keeper and the agents; the web app serves pages, the API and a live stream" caption="Money moves only between your wallet and the contracts. Everything else is a read model or a helper." />

| Part | What it is | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **Contracts** | CashScript and SolidCash covenants holding every round, gate, ticket and vault | `packages/contracts` |
| **SDK** | Oracle message codec and pair finder, commitment layouts, payout maths, lanes; shared by the browser and the engine | `packages/sdk` |
| **Web app** | Next.js 16: every page, the read API, a live stream (SSE), Sensei | `apps/web` |
| **Engine** | One Node process: oracle relay, price line, indexer, keeper, agents, push, paths, faucet | `services/engine` |
| **Database** | Postgres with Drizzle: a read model rebuilt from raw transactions, plus NOTIFY channels | `packages/db` |
| **Chart** | A zero-dependency canvas chart: the 60 Hz round chart and candles | `packages/chart` |
| **Brain** | The model layer: which model answers, Sensei's prompt, the agents' read and gate | `packages/brain` |

## Three rules the design keeps

| Rule | How |
|---|---|
| **Your browser trusts the chain, not us** | Entries are built in the browser from live coins read off public Fulcrum servers and broadcast there. Our database feeds lists, history and leaderboards, never a signature |
| **Nobody has to be online** | Lock, settle and pay have exactly one valid form, need no key, and are paid from the round. The keeper sends them; any browser can ([Anyone can finish](/docs/rounds/anyone-can-finish)) |
| **AI never holds your money** | Sensei only suggests. Agents sign from a vault whose covenant allows only entries that pay you ([Vault](/docs/agents/vault)) |

## Live data

The engine writes to Postgres and sends a tiny `NOTIFY` (`joge_oracle`, `joge_price`, `joge_round`, `joge_agent`). The web app holds one `LISTEN` per process and fans it out over one Server-Sent Events stream per tab, `/api/stream`; pages refetch through TanStack Query. The chart eases each new price at 60 Hz, at a pace that follows how often the feed actually ticks.

## Stack

| | |
|---|---|
| Chain | Bitcoin Cash, CashTokens, CashScript 0.14, SolidCash 0.51, `@bitauth/libauth` |
| Wallets | WizardConnect (`@wizardconnect/react` 0.2.6) |
| Chain access | Fulcrum over WebSocket (`@rpckit`), five public servers |
| Prices | General Protocols oracle (SSE + REST), Kraken WebSocket v2 for the live line |
| App | Next.js 16, React 19, TanStack Query, Tailwind 4 |
| AI | AI SDK 7, `openai/gpt-5.4-mini` by default |
| Video | Mediabunny (H.264 + AAC in the browser, WebCodecs) |
| Data | Postgres 17, Drizzle |
| Monorepo | pnpm, Turbo, Biome, TypeScript |
| Hosting | Docker on Coolify |
